subject: Re: Multi-year prepay proposal — ramp flexibility & term credit request
messages:
From: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@nimbushealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.pace@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:13:00 -0400
Subject: Multi-year prepay proposal — ramp flexibility & term credit request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Nimbus is very interested in committing to Redwood but we have two constraints that are blockers for internal sign-off: 1) we need a bespoke ramp — we will only be consuming ~25% of year-1 capacity in Q1/Q2 as we integrate, and 2) finance wants a stronger onboarding credit to offset initial implementation costs (we're asking for $150k).

We are evaluating a 3-year prepay (~$3M total commit) and would like to understand whether Redwood can:
- Provide a term discount in the 30–40% range across the term (volume-weighted)
- Allow a front-loaded credit for onboarding ($150k)
- Accept a two-step ramp where usage floors increase after 12 and 24 months rather than a straight linear ramp

This is time-sensitive — Nimbus needs final commercial terms to present to their board next Wednesday. Attached is a draft SOW that includes their target timeline.

Appreciate any flexibility and a quick turnaround.

Best,
Sasha Morgan
CFO, Nimbus Health
Attachments: NIMBO_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 214KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: jordan.pace@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay proposal — ramp flexibility & term credit request

Hi Sasha — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I can confirm we want Nimbus as a strategic customer and I will escalate for approvals internally.

Quick note: we may need to trade off the size of the onboarding credit against the term discount and the ramp mechanics. I'll follow up with an internal proposal and loop in Finance and Legal. Aim to get back to you by Monday EOD.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Multi-year prepay proposal — ramp flexibility & term credit request

Vivek / Karthik — forwarding Nimbus request. Summary: 3-year prepay ~$3M, asking for 30–40% term discount and $150k onboarding credit; bespoke ramp (25% Y1 consumption initially).

Proposed commercial counter (my recommendation):
- 3-year prepaid commit of $3.0M
- Term discount: 35% effective on model list rates (volume-weighted)
- One-time onboarding credit: $125,000 (to be amortized over the first 12 months)
- Ramp schedule: Year1 floor = 30% of Year1 committed tokens (to reflect integration), Year2 = 70% Year2 committed, Year3 = 100%

Rationale: preserves gross margin relative to their ask while giving meaningful upfront savings. The onboarding credit and discount are material — will need Finance & Legal signoff for revenue recognition and T&Cs.

Please advise whether you can sign off at Director level or if this needs exec approval. Also attaching a quick pricing workbook.

Attachments: proposed_pricing.xlsx (xls, 46KB)

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Director signoff needed — Nimbus Health non-standard ramp & term credit (NW-48921)

Team — need quick guidance/approval.

Deal summary: Nimbus Health (target close this month) — wants a 3-year prepaid commit ($3.0M) with a 30–40% term discount request plus $150k onboarding credit. Marissa proposes 35% + $125k credit + bespoke ramp (30% Y1 floor). This is a strategic win (healthcare vertical, potential reference), but the economics are tight in Y1 due to low consumption expectations.

Ask: Can Finance and Legal approve a one-time onboarding credit of $125k and a 35% effective discount on a 3-year prepay? If not, what’s the maximum discount + credit package you can sign off at Director level without needing CRO/CEO escalation? If this requires higher approval, I will escalate immediately but want to avoid blocking the board deadline.

Key considerations for approval:
- Revenue recognition: how to amortize the onboarding credit vs. upfront recognition
- Margin impact in Y1 (we need to ensure contribution margin stays positive after credit)
- Contractual clause tying discounts/credits to commit & clawbacks if usage materially underdelivers

I’m including a suggested conditional approval path: Finance approves up to 32% + $100k credit at Director signoff; anything more needs CRO approval. Happy to adjust if you have a tighter constraint.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — East
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Director signoff needed — Nimbus Health non-standard ramp & term credit (NW-48921)

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary. Reviewed the proposed numbers and constraints. Finance position: we can approve a conditional package at Director level with the following guardrails:

- Approved commercial package (Director signoff): 32% effective term discount + $100,000 one-time onboarding credit
- Onboarding credit to be amortized over 12 months for revenue recognition; credit will be subject to a clawback if Nimbus terminates within 12 months or fails to meet the Year1 minimum usage floor (to be defined in contract)
- Require Legal to add explicit clawback language and a minimum annual consumption commitment in SOW; Finance will not approve upfront recognition without the clawback in place

If Sales wants to push to 35% / $125k, this requires CRO approval (I will escalate immediately if you ask).

Laura — please confirm you can draft the contractual language quickly (we need to move fast). Marissa — please confirm whether Nimbus will accept the conditional package; if they insist on $150k / 35%, we will need an exec call.

—Naomi
Director, Commercial Finance
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Pace <jordan.pace@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 20:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay proposal — ramp flexibility & term credit request

Sasha — thanks for your patience. Internal approvals are complete at Director level. We can move forward on the following conditional commercial terms for Nimbus Health (Deal NW-48921):

- 3-year prepaid commitment: $3,000,000 total
- Effective term discount: 32% off list prices (applies across the prepaid balance)
- One-time onboarding credit: $100,000 (to be applied to the first invoice, amortized over 12 months for accounting)
- Agreed ramp mechanics: Year1 usage floor = 30% of Year1 commit; Year2 floor = 70%; Year3 = 100%
- Clawback: onboarding credit subject to clawback if contract terminates within 12 months or if Year1 usage falls below the agreed floor (legal to draft)

Laura is drafting the contract language and will circulate a redline later today. If these terms are acceptable, please indicate and we will send a DocuSign SOW with the above commercial summary.

We’re excited to partner with Nimbus and will prioritize onboarding to hit the ramp milestones.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — East
